name: Róhe
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $540 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Tailored coats, blazers, trousers, knitwear and silk tops in Italian fabrics, trousers around €550 and coats €1,300 (euro prices shown), sold through its New York store and site.
origin: Founded in 2021 by Marieke Meulendijks; Maickel Weyers.

quote.q: When you buy Róhe, you feel the love, the fit, the fabric, the stitching, the finish, everything is considered, everything is intentional.
quote.who: Marieke Meulendijks, founder and creative director

opview: “When you buy Róhe, you feel the love, the fit, the fabric, the stitching, the finish, everything is considered, everything is intentional.” — Marieke Meulendijks, founder and creative director, The Brand & Founders, roheframes.com

facts_read.source: brand site (founders, house, store, heritage, Pankou collection, PF26 lookbook, terms); Who What Wear 2024-12-25; Liberty London feature; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer index; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Róhe women's ready-to-wear; EXCLUDED: home, scarves, hats

doors.note: Domain is roheframes.com (Róhe Frames). 'The Store' page describes one store, the New York Flagship at 77 Mercer Street, Soho; no ZIP or phone published.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 of 208 clothing styles (344 feed records less home, objects, accessories, hats, scarves = 292 listings, collapsed on the style name befo

craft_evidence.owned: design atelier only — in-house atelier in the Herengracht house, Amsterdam (draping, in-house pattern making); production is outsourced
craft_evidence.makers: no — 'smaller family businesses … mainly based in Europe', unnamed
craft_evidence.heritage: founder named (Marieke Meulendijks); Amsterdam house described; no founding date read
craft_evidence.process: design process only (sourcing, draping, pattern making), not making
craft_evidence.reasoning: An in-house atelier is located (Amsterdam), but it does pattern making and fit, not production. Production is said to be with European family businesses, none named, and product pages almost never state a country. Located design work with unnamed makers is a 2.
